correctness.rationale: The harmonic mean is a valid homogeneous normalized member of the defining class. For each unit pair and scale, norming support functionals reduce the arithmetic chord sum to N8*(f+g)+t N8*(f-g). Exhaustive evaluation of the eight support functionals yields exactly five dual-norm pairs: (2,0), (0,2), (2,2r), (2r,2), and (sqrt2,sqrt2), with r=sqrt2-1. Each gives at most 2+2rt on 0<=t<=1. Harmonic mean <= arithmetic mean therefore gives the universal numerator bound 1+rt. The fixed vertices u=(1,r), v=(-r,1) have both chord norms exactly 1+rt for every t, so the bound is sharp pointwise. The remaining maximization is the Hölder quotient of (1,r) against (1,t), attaining ||(1,r)||_q at t=r^(1/(p-1)), with the endpoint cases checked separately.
risks: The finite numerical checker is supplementary; the continuum conclusion relies on the analytic five-pair support enumeration and Hölder equality.

originality.rationale: The complete 2019 defining article was inspected, including the family definition, Lemma 2.1 reduction, the list of standard specializations, Example 2.4, later characterizations, and all remaining pages. It contains no occurrence or calculation of the harmonic mean 2ab/(a+b) and no regular-octagonal example. The 2022 full-text follow-up was inspected where it recalls the family and its applications; it does not provide this profile. Semantic searches using the exact family notation, harmonic-mean formula, regular-octagon aliases, the candidate Hölder profile, and related power/geometric-mean formulations found no covering statement. Closest regular-octagon records optimize different means or different admissible pairs, so none logically implies the harmonic profile.
residual_risks: Bibliographic and semantic search cannot establish absolute novelty.
An equivalent harmonic calculation could be written under another symbol for the harmonic mean or an affine-equivalent octagon normalization.
Only abstract-level public material was available for the 2026 skew extension, although its changed vector pair makes it non-dominating for the symmetric claim.
risks: No independent human literature audit has been performed.

value.rationale: This is not a one-off numerical specialization. The harmonic mean is a canonical classical mean lying inside the 2019 general family, and the result resolves its entire exponent profile on a canonical non-Hilbert polygonal plane. The formula exposes an exact Hölder-dual structure, C_{h,p}=||(1,sqrt2-1)||_q, and one fixed vertex pair is pointwise sharp for every scale, so all exponent dependence comes from a transparent scalar duality. The supporting chord envelope is stronger than the final harmonic value and can be reused for other monotone means dominated by the arithmetic mean.
risks: The result is a canonical two-dimensional benchmark, not a general classification theorem for all members of Lambda.
